Research log

  • 2026-11-16 08:49 Run 388 (music (where Christmas songs chart worldwide, the bilingual Feliz Navidad jump, the cosy folk lane)): Infant music studies were already in the tree, so this round looked at Christmas listening: in Christmas week 2025 YouTube's charts were full of holiday songs in the US, UK, Europe, Australia and Japan but had few or none in India, Brazil and South Africa; the bilingual Feliz Navidad jumped 61 places that week; and the cosy 'Folksy Christmas' playlist grew about 30x since 2019 while the main hits playlist stayed cheerful. Total 1617.
  • 2026-11-16 08:47 Run 387 (TRENDS (zoom in hidden message, then and now, Wrapped recaps in early December)): Inmagic's 16 Nov list keeps the 'It's time' Christmas switch at No. 1 and the Dame Hombro shoulder dance in the top 10, and adds two kid usable formats: a 'zoom in' Reel hiding tiny text for viewers to find and 'then and now' clips cut on a strong beat. Spotify Wrapped is expected around 2 Dec, the start of the yearly recap trend. Total 1613.
  • 2026-11-16 08:47 Run 386 (Shorts and Reels (2026 short video benchmarks: 14 second average Short watch, non follower share, Shorts plus long form growth)): Instagram's algorithm news was already in the tree, so this round gathered Kapwing's July 2026 short video benchmarks: the average Short is watched about 14 seconds, 74% of Shorts views and 55% of Reels views come from people who do not follow the account, and channels that combine Shorts with long videos grow about 41% faster; captions raise completion sharply. Total 1609.
  • 2026-11-16 08:46 Run 385 (algorithm (subscriber click rates, repeat recommendation cap, live watch time abroad)): Most algorithm news was already in the tree; new details are that even top videos get about one click in ten from the Subscriptions row, that YouTube has tested capping how often one video is re-recommended to the same viewer at eight times, and that over 40% of live watch time comes from outside the creator's home country, which supports a global 24/7 Bro Bros stream. Total 1604.
  • 2026-11-16 08:45 Run 384 (TRENDS (holiday piano sway dance returns each December, DreamToys 2026 themes)): Last December families revived the awkward cartoon party dance from the classic Charlie Brown Christmas special (one video 4.3M views), a seasonal dance that will likely return this December; the UK DreamToys list (11 Nov 2026) shows what kids will be playing with at Christmas: dinosaur vehicles, a pet tiger that grows, hatching robot sharks, slime and squishies, a pirate ship and K-pop singing dolls. Total 1601.
  • 2026-11-16 08:44 Run 383 (YouTube channels (our Metricool check already done today so skipped; VocaVoca's 2026 surge and cool down, Pokémon Kids TV)): VocaVoca was 2026's breakout nursery song channel, rising from about 368M views in January to 2.91B in October (5M to 10.5M subscribers), but its last 28 days fell to about 1.46B, matching its exit from the weekly top 50; its newest upload pairs a helper mission with this season's toy train theme. Pokémon Kids TV adds about 1.2M subscribers a month on only about 71M views, so big IP subscriber counts say little about views. Total 1597.
  • 2026-11-16 08:43 Run 382 (rules (Shorts originality ranking from 1 Oct, AI monetisation risk tiers)): Most rules topics were already covered; new is YouTube's 1 Oct 2026 change that judges Shorts originality per channel and cuts reach for channels that mainly re-upload others' clips (no warning, no status check, no recovery timeline), plus a risk ladder for AI assisted channels: AI music inside creator led videos is low risk, near identical daily uploads are medium, title swap template clones are high. Total 1592.
  • 2026-11-16 08:42 Run 381 (TRENDS (rock paper scissors snack game, pose and bow, gratitude tablecloth, one week meme lifespans)): Virlo's late October tracker shows two family friendly TikTok formats still early: a rock paper scissors game where the winner takes a bite, and a pose then bow on the beat drop; it also shows memes now rise and die within a single week. TikTok's holiday shopping event opened on 14 Nov, and the US gratitude tablecloth tradition (kids trace their hands) returns for Thanksgiving on 26 Nov. Total 1589.
  • 2026-11-16 08:41 Run 380 (competitors (Lalafun's fivefold growth and mission titles, BabyBus flat)): Lalafun's main channel jumped from about 139M views in April to 600M to 720M a month from May to October 2026 (+600K to 700K subscribers a month), and its breakouts all pair a classic rhyme with a toddler mission in the title ('Catch the Black Sheep!' 33M in 9 weeks); BabyBus English holds a steady 220M a month and, like Lalafun, has no Christmas upload yet, while both just released boo boo and sharing songs. Total 1584.
  • 2026-11-16 08:40 Run 379 (global markets (Arabic content gap, Arabic lullabies, higher paying smaller European languages)): Abu Dhabi's culture chief said in September that about 80% of what Arab children watch is not in Arabic, and Arabic lullabies are so scarce that Spacetoon and Moonbug made four originals this year, so an Arabic dub of our bedtime songs fills a real gap; AIR's vendor data puts smaller European languages (Polish, Czech, Hungarian, Greek, Romanian) at 3 to 6 times Indonesia's ad rate per view. Total 1578.
